name: Fried Rice

Optional Toppings.item: spam or any meat of choice

directions: In a pan place oil in and heat up until hot
Add in finely chopped garlic sauté until fragrent, if wanted, add in eggs in this step too
Put heat on low and add in vegatables and any optional toppings sauté until cooked through
Take out the vegtables and toppings and set aside
Heat up some oil again and add rice. Add a splash of water if the rice is very hard. Cover and let sit on medium heat for 5 minutes
Uncover rice, add in toppings and vegatables, and sauté until will incorperated
Add any seasoning, salt and peper and str fry until well incorperated and to taste
